//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const privateFileAccess windows.ACCESS_MASK = 0x001f01ff

func rejectPrivateReparsePath(path string) error {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || len(filepath.VolumeName(path)) != 2 {
		return errors.New("private fixture path must be on a local drive")
	}
	for current := filepath.Clean(path); ; current = filepath.Dir(current) {
		pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(current)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		attributes, err := windows.GetFileAttributes(pointer)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if attributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("private fixture path contains a reparse point: %s", current)
		}
		if current == filepath.Dir(current) {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func privateDescriptor(directory bool) (*windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR, *windows.SID, error) {
	user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	owner := user.User.Sid
	flags := ""
	if directory {
		flags = "OICI"
	}
	descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("O:" + owner.String() + "D:P(A;" + flags + ";FA;;;" + owner.String() + ")(A;" + flags + ";FA;;;SY)")
	return descriptor, owner, err
}

func createPrivateDirectory(path string) error {
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(filepath.Dir(path)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	descriptor, _, err := privateDescriptor(true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	attributes := windows.SecurityAttributes{Length: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.SecurityAttributes{})), SecurityDescriptor: descriptor}
	if err := windows.CreateDirectory(pointer, &attributes); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validatePrivateDirectory(path)
}

func validatePrivateDirectory(path string) error { return validatePrivateWindowsPath(path, true) }
func validatePrivateFile(path string) error      { return validatePrivateWindowsPath(path, false) }

func validatePrivateWindowsPath(path string, directory bool) error {
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() != directory || (!directory && !info.Mode().IsRegular()) {
		return errors.New("private fixture path has the wrong file type")
	}
	descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
		return errors.New("private fixture DACL is not protected")
	}
	user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if owner == nil || !owner.Equals(user.User.Sid) {
		return errors.New("private fixture owner differs from the current user")
	}
	acl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if acl == nil || acl.AceCount != 2 {
		return errors.New("private fixture DACL must contain only owner and SYSTEM grants")
	}
	flags := uint8(0)
	if directory {
		flags = windows.OBJECT_INHERIT_ACE | windows.CONTAINER_INHERIT_ACE
	}
	ownerSeen, systemSeen := false, false
	for index := uint32(0); index < uint32(acl.AceCount); index++ {
		var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
		if err := windows.GetAce(acl, index, &ace); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if ace == nil || ace.Header.AceType != windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE || ace.Header.AceFlags != flags || ace.Mask != privateFileAccess {
			return errors.New("private fixture DACL contains an unexpected ACE")
		}
		sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
		if !sid.IsValid() || int(ace.Header.AceSize) < int(unsafe.Offsetof(ace.SidStart))+sid.Len() {
			return errors.New("private fixture ACE has an invalid SID")
		}
		switch {
		case sid.Equals(user.User.Sid):
			ownerSeen = true
			if sid.IsWellKnown(windows.WinLocalSystemSid) {
				systemSeen = true
			}
		case sid.IsWellKnown(windows.WinLocalSystemSid):
			systemSeen = true
		default:
			return errors.New("private fixture DACL grants access to another principal")
		}
	}
	if !ownerSeen || !systemSeen {
		return errors.New("private fixture DACL is missing an owner or SYSTEM grant")
	}
	return nil
}

func makePrivateFile(path string) error {
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(filepath.Dir(path)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return errors.New("private fixture file is not regular")
	}
	descriptor, owner, err := privateDescriptor(false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	acl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if acl == nil {
		return errors.New("private file descriptor lacks DACL")
	}
	if err := windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION, owner, nil, acl, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validatePrivateFile(path)
}
